nodes.description: Public mapping storing token balances per address; written on mint/transfer and read on burn/transfer.
Public nested mapping of owner to spender to approved amount; read and written by _approvalDecrease/_approve.
Public total token supply; increased on mint and decreased on burn/transfer-to-dead.
Immutable token decimal count set in the constructor.
Token name state variable, set in the constructor and used in DOMAIN_SEPARATOR hashing.
Token symbol state variable, set in the constructor.
Immutable EIP-712 domain separator computed at deploy time from name, chainId and address(this).
Mapping of owner to permit nonce; incremented inside permit.
Immutable EIP-2612 permit typehash constant.
Deploys the token: mints initial supply to msg.sender and sets decimals, name and symbol.
Internal mint: increases recipient balance and totalSupply and emits Transfer from address(0).
External burn: burns amount from msg.sender via _burn.
External burn allowing an approved spender to destroy tokens of 'from' after decreasing the approval.
Internal burn: decreases balance and totalSupply and emits Transfer to address(0) plus Burn.
External approval entrypoint that delegates to _approve for msg.sender.
Internal approval writer: sets allowance[from][spender] and emits Approval.
External transfer of tokens from msg.sender to 'to'.
External transferFrom: decreases the spender approval then moves tokens between accounts.
Internal transfer that debits the sender and credits the recipient, treating address(0), 0xdEaD and the contract itself as burns.
Internal helper reducing allowance[from][msg.sender]; contains an inverted comparison require(v < amount).
EIP-2612 permit: verifies an ECDSA signature against DOMAIN_SEPARATOR and deadline, increments nonce and approves.
Internal view that returns the current chain id via inline assembly.
Caller-controlled address used as recipient of initial mint and as the debited account in burn/approve/transfer/transferFrom.
Block timestamp compared against the permit deadline.
balanceOf[to] += amount in _mint; unchecked-add style balance mutation.
totalSupply += amount in _mint; supply arithmetic.
balanceOf[from] -= amount in _burn; subtraction reachable with user-supplied amount.
totalSupply -= amount in _burn; supply arithmetic.
balanceOf[from] -= amount in _transfer; sender balance arithmetic.
totalSupply -= amount in _transfer when sending to a dead address.
balanceOf[to] += amount in _transfer; recipient balance arithmetic.
v - amount arithmetic inside _approvalDecrease computing the new allowance.
nonces[_owner]++ inside permit; permits with the same nonce are rejected.
require(v < amount, 'approval too small') inside _approvalDecrease; inverted guard permits spending above the allowance.

Amount moved by transferFrom.
Signer/owner claimed by the permit signature.

Allowance value authorised by the permit.
Expiry timestamp supplied to permit.
Address returned by ecrecover in permit.
EIP-712 digest assembled in permit.
Current allowance read from allowance[from][msg.sender].
Chain id read through inline assembly.

_mint writes totalSupply.
